# Potts Deck & Patio

> Custom deck and patio builder serving Central Texas: Belton, Temple,
> Killeen, Salado, and surrounding communities. Free on-site estimates.

Potts Deck & Patio designs and builds outdoor living spaces for Central
Texas homeowners:

- Custom wood decks (pressure-treated pine and cedar), including multi-level
  and slope-side builds with cable or wood railing
- Composite decks with hidden fasteners — low-maintenance, no staining
- Cedar pergolas, attached or freestanding
- Covered patios with finished ceilings, fans, and lighting
- Screened porches and screen enclosures
- Boardwalks, outdoor staircases, and specialty structures
